local_facts.claim: San Bernardino County’s I-15 Comprehensive Corridor Study reports 110,000 to 120,000 average daily vehicles at SR-138 and Cleghorn Road, Friday daily traffic above 130,000, holiday-Friday traffic nearing 150,000, and more than 90% autos on weekend days. The study corridor reaches the Mojave River crossing at Victorville.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A Victorville freeway collision may involve long-distance weekend travelers, multiple insurers, and witnesses or vehicles already headed out of the High Desert. The direction of travel, nearest exit, responding agency, tow yard, and original evidence need to be identified early rather than treated like a neighborhood-only crash.
local_facts.title: I-15 carries a distinct High Desert traffic mix

local_facts.claim: The same county I-15 study describes Cajon Pass grades approaching 6% for roughly five miles, truck speeds restricted below 45 mph on the southbound descent while auto speeds exceed 65 mph, crash rates 58% above similar facilities, and rear-end collisions as the predominant crash type.
local_facts.why_it_matters: The road grade, speed differential, lane, traffic queue, and sequence of impacts can be central evidence in a freeway claim. A precise account is especially important in commercial-vehicle and multi-car crashes, where a broad description of “traffic stopped” may leave out the facts needed to evaluate fault.
local_facts.title: Cajon Pass conditions make collision detail matter

local_facts.claim: The Superior Court of California, County of San Bernardino lists the Civil Division of the Victorville District at 14455 Civic Drive in Victorville. The court says the location accepts limited and unlimited civil matters and serves Victorville and several High Desert communities.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A nearby civil filing division is part of the practical local map after a serious crash. The proper venue still depends on the particular parties and facts, so it should be confirmed rather than assumed from an insurer’s correspondence or a mailing address.
local_facts.title: Victorville has a civil division for High Desert filings

pricing.table_head: San Bernardino County filing amounts, and the California rules that govern a fee

anchors.label: Local courthouse construction surcharge
anchors.detail: San Bernardino is one of three California counties whose first-paper filings carry a local surcharge, which is why limited civil filings cost more here than the statewide figure.
anchors.source_name: San Bernardino Superior Court civil fee schedule appendix

anchors.label: Limited civil first paper, over $10,000 up to $35,000
anchors.detail: Ten dollars above the $370 statewide amount once the surcharge is applied. A claim pleaded under $10,000 costs $240 here rather than $225.
anchors.source_name: San Bernardino Superior Court civil fee schedule appendix

anchors.label: Percentage ceiling written into California law for a crash claim
anchors.detail: Rule 1.5 forbids an unconscionable or illegal fee and lists thirteen factors for judging one. It sets no rate for ordinary negligence work of any kind.
anchors.source_name: Cal. Rules of Prof. Conduct, rule 1.5

anchors.label: Contract defect remedy
anchors.detail: A contingency agreement that omits anything section 6147 requires is voidable at the plaintiff's option, and the lawyer is then held to a reasonable fee instead.

fee_rows.stage: Unlimited civil first paper, San Bernardino
fee_rows.note: The surcharge is offset in this tier, so the High Desert courthouses charge the same $435 as the rest of the state for a case pleading over $35,000.
fee_rows.source_name: San Bernardino Superior Court civil fee schedule

fee_rows.stage: Limited civil first paper, San Bernardino
fee_rows.note: Both figures include the county's $35 courthouse construction surcharge. The split falls at a $10,000 pleaded amount.
fee_rows.source_name: San Bernardino Superior Court civil fee schedule appendix

fee_rows.note: Nonrefundable advance jury fee, then sixty dollars per paper requiring a hearing and five hundred for a summary judgment motion.
fee_rows.source_name: San Bernardino Superior Court civil fee schedule

fee_rows.stage: How a contingency rate is set
fee_rows.note: Section 6147 requires the rate in a signed contract, with a duplicate copy handed over, plus a statement that the fee is not fixed by law.
